title: Lagged loose U.S. financial-conditions DRA V1 entry admission
thesis: A publisher-defined loose U.S. financial-conditions state may distinguish DRA momentum entries supported by broad risk-bearing capacity from entries formed under tighter money, debt, equity and banking conditions. Vetoing new parent entries when the lagged NFCI is zero or positive may improve equal-capital DRA economics without changing exits or existing lots.
mechanism: For weekly Friday-ending NFCI observation D, begin using the value only at D plus seven calendar days 00:00 UTC and for at most 168 hours. Admit an otherwise unchanged DRA V1 parent signal only when NFCI is strictly below the publisher-defined zero; otherwise veto the new entry and leave all existing lots and exits untouched.
economic_rationale: The feature is useful only if it improves Design and Validation total and realized PnL while preserving unrealized PnL, drawdown, underwater duration, holding and terminal inventory, intervenes often enough, and has annual and predictive breadth. Broad risk-on correlation, one crisis year, fewer trades or terminal-inventory cleanup is insufficient.
